R709.note: Placeholder-and-arg fix is correct in shape but the build fails - the now-unused fmt import was left behind, which breaks the whole package and is not mentioned.

R710.note: Exemption narrowed to /api/webhooks/** exactly as the file's own comment intends; webhook callers and all other routes keep working, nothing else touched.

R711.note: userId is threaded into loadProjectExport but the ownership comparison is only a comment - the store still returns any project whenever userId is truthy, so an authenticated user can still export another user's project.

R712.note: Sandboxed JEXL replaces GroovyShell and closes code execution, but it silently swaps the formula language, so stored Groovy formulas using anything beyond plain arithmetic now fail and fall back to basePrice - the migration is never stated, and the claim that JEXL is 'already in the classpath per pom.xml' has no pom.xml in the case to support it.

R713.note: position < record.size() before operator[] closes the out-of-bounds write; in-range edits behave identically and the skip of out-of-range edits is stated.

R714.note: Signature verification and an algorithm allowlist are correct, but the key is a hardcoded literal 'your-secret-key' - a well-known placeholder is forgeable, and every token signed with the app's real key now 401s; the write-up flags this only as a production caveat.

R715.note: proc_open argument array removes the shell entirely and keeps the grep -F -- ordering, so pattern semantics, exit-code handling and JSON output are unchanged.

R716.note: Column/direction allowlist plus orderBy() closes the raw-SQL sink; the default 'created_at desc' still parses and the restriction is what the stated contract asks for, with account_id and the range window untouched.

R717.note: RFC 4515 escaping of backslash, asterisk, parens and NUL with backslash replaced first; escaped values still match the same literal usernames and nothing else in the handler changed.

R718.note: space_left = sizeof(path) - strlen(path) - 1 is computed against the destination's real capacity and checked before strcat; names that previously fit still succeed, over-long ones now return -1 rather than overflowing.

R719.note: text() with a :date_filter bind parameter; psycopg2 renders the same quoted literal the original produced, so result rows and the handler signature are unchanged.

R720.note: PreparedStatement with setString binds the parameter and the finally block was updated to close it - same query, same IO.writeLine output, same exception logging.

R721.note: Escapes the RFC 4515 set (asterisk, parens, backslash, NUL) before concatenation; the extra \2f for '/' is a legal escape the server unescapes, so matching semantics are preserved.

R722.note: Exact-match-or-prefix-with-separator check rejects /srv/app/uploads-backup while every path genuinely under uploads still serves, with the error path and status unchanged.
